scope: Current-only controlled CLI/MCP parity experiment; no agent task, token, cost or general speedup claim.
association: Collector associates the outer receipt and inner log hashes after collection. The outer receipt seal itself does not bind inner logs; matching identities are consistency observations, not execution attestation.
projection: Raw logs retain process snapshots. This projection keeps all per-batch CPU tick and waited-child CPU deltas and maximum observed RSS/HWM; 100 Hz zeros do not establish zero CPU, and process peaks are not a simultaneous tree peak.

runs.resource_scope: per-process /proc warm batch deltas and RSS/HWM observations; no summed tree peak. Waited-child CPU covers reaped children. Outer performance receipt excludes systemd daemon; not total MCP resources.
runs.protocol_accounting_scope: initialize and two tools/list replies validated; initialized notification counted as completed write, not acknowledged processing
runs.cache_scope: process-cold setup and first calls; kernel/filesystem caches uncontrolled
